letter.company_line: Tigerform is a commercial concrete structure company based in Moorabbin.
letter.subject: Project Coordinator, Moorabbin
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Project Coordinator role advertised on SEEK. Reviewing shop drawings for missing information and clashes, tracking procurement dates, keeping document registers current and following up RFIs is the kind of coordination work I enjoy.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements and kept the client up to date. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site, material and progress reports. On the renovation I checked work against project requirements and escalated issues early to cut down on errors and rework.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, where I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

I hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton VIC. My coordination experience is from the Philippines and I have not yet worked on commercial concrete structures, so I would learn your processes quickly and make sure site works from the latest approved drawings.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
